name: photo.street/catalogue
title: street.photo
description: Clint's street photography: photo capsules, art prints and exhibitions in French and English.

tools.name: search_capsules
tools.description: Search published street.photo photographs by keywords, location, year or collection. Returns previews and capsule page links. / Rechercher les photographies publiées de street.photo par mots-clés, lieu, année ou collection. Retourne des aperçus et les liens des capsules.

query.description: Keywords in the title and current-language texts; lexical search.

city.description: City or part of its name.

country_code.description: Two-letter uppercase ISO country code, for example FR.

per_page.description: Results per page, 10 by default and at most 20.

locale.description: Language of the result / Langue du résultat.

tools.name: get_capsule
tools.description: Read the published story, location, date and music associated with a photograph using its public capsule number. / Lire le récit publié, le lieu, la date et la musique associés à une photographie à partir de son numéro de capsule.

capsule_number.description: Public capsule number, supplied by search.

locale.description: Language of the result / Langue du résultat.

tools.name: compare_print_options
tools.description: Compare available print configurations: edition, required finish and current price for one copy. The budget is in euros, excluding delivery. / Comparer les configurations disponibles d’un tirage : édition, finition obligatoire et prix actuel pour un exemplaire. Le budget est exprimé en euros, hors livraison.

capsule_number.description: Public capsule number, supplied by search.

budget_eur.description: Maximum budget in euros for one print including its finish, excluding delivery.

per_page.description: Results per page, 10 by default and at most 20.

locale.description: Language of the result / Langue du résultat.

tools.name: list_exhibitions
tools.description: Read Clint’s public exhibitions, venues and dates with time zones. Returns current and upcoming exhibitions by default. / Consulter les expositions publiques de Clint, leurs lieux et dates avec fuseaux horaires. Par défaut, retourne les expositions en cours et à venir.

period.description: Exhibition period relative to the current date.

city.description: City or part of its name.

from_date.description: First intended visit day, YYYY-MM-DD, in each exhibition’s own time zone.

to_date.description: Last intended visit day inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD, in each exhibition’s own time zone.

per_page.description: Results per page, 10 by default and at most 20.

locale.description: Language of the result / Langue du résultat.

tools.name: get_site_information
tools.description: Read published, administered information about the artist, studio, app, contact and purchasing. / Lire les informations publiées et administrées sur l’artiste, le studio, l’application, le contact et les modalités d’achat.

locale.description: Language of the result / Langue du résultat.
